title: 10 things in tech you need to know today (AAPL, CSCO, FB, CRM)
text:
10 things in tech you need to know today (AAPL, CSCO, FB, CRM) Posted By: BusinessInsider February 15, 2018 
Good morning! Here’s the technology news you need to know this Thursday morning. 
1. Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Hathaway loaded up on more Apple stock. In the fourth quarter, the Nebraska-based firm upped its holdings of Apple by 23% to 31.2 million shares. Its stake is now worth $165.3 million (£117 million). 
2. Cisco’s revenue is finally growing again and investors are piling in. The computer networking company forecast financial results for the current quarter that topped Wall Street targets, sending its stock up 5% in after hours trading on Wednesday.
